dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.ordersBody: Receive and manage orders in real time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.addressBody: Customers open your menu at this address. Your printed QR codes keep working even if it changes later.
settings.addressFixed: Changing the café address is not available yet — contact us if you need it.
settings.detailsBody: Shown on your menu. The currency and time zone are used for prices and orders.
settings.contactBody: How customers reach your café: phone and email, plus your Facebook and Instagram pages.
settings.colourBody: Your menu's colours are generated from this colour.

profile.emailPending: Confirmed. Now open the link we sent to your other address to finish the change.
profile.languageBody: The language of your dashboard and of the emails Serbi sends you.
profile.emailBody: Changing it needs a confirmation: we email a link to the new address (and to your current one). The change happens once confirmed.
profile.waitingFor: Waiting for confirmation of {email}. Open the link we emailed.
profile.passwordBody: Enter your current password, then the new one. Other devices are signed out.
profile.passwordRules: At least 10 characters with an upper-case letter, a digit and a symbol.

languagesTab.offeredBody: Customers can read your menu and website in these languages. Texts you haven't translated yet show in your main language.
languagesTab.mainHint: Main language — change it in the Café tab
languagesTab.requestBody: Serbi can add languages like Spanish, Italian or German to your café. Send a request — we'll notify you when it's reviewed.
languagesTab.whyHint: e.g. Many Italian tourists visit us in summer
languagesTab.allRequested: All supported languages are available or requested.

fields.phoneIncomplete: Keep typing — the number looks incomplete for this country.

media.reused: {count, plural, one {This photo was already uploaded — reused it} other {# photos were already uploaded — reused them}}

menu.title: Menu
menu.summary: {categories} categories · {items} items. Changes show to customers within a minute.
menu.emptyDescription: Your categories and items, with prices and photos.
menu.emptyBody: Start from a ready-made café menu (Coffee, Tea, Pastries, Cold drinks — in your menu language) and edit it, or start empty. Items show to customers once they have a price.
menu.notPriced: {count, plural, one {# item has no price yet — customers don't see it until you set one.} other {# items have no price yet — customers don't see them until you set one.}}
menu.deleteCategoryBody: Only empty categories can be deleted. Move or delete its items first.
menu.deleteItemBody: It disappears from your menu. This can't be undone.
menu.translationNote: {language} translation. Empty fields show the {main} text.
menu.name: Name
menu.priceHint: Leave empty to keep it hidden for now
menu.availableCheck: Available — uncheck when it's sold out
menu.featuredCheck: Featured — shown on your website's "Signature specialties"

options.title: Options
options.hint: Sizes, milk, extras… Customers choose them when ordering; a choice can add to the price.

tables.title: Tables & QR
tables.description: Your areas and tables, and the QR codes customers scan to open your menu.
tables.menuQrBody: For your counter, window, flyers or takeaway bags. It opens your menu without a table. Each table below has its own code, so orders know where to go.
tables.menuQrStats: {scans} scans in the last 30 days · code {code}
tables.startBody: An area is a room or zone of your café — e.g. Inside or Terrace. Then add its tables.
tables.areaSummary: {width} × {depth} m · {tables, plural, one {# table} other {# tables}} · {seats, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}
tables.help3d: Drag to turn around · scroll or pinch to zoom · click a table for its QR code. Arrange tables in the Floor plan.
tables.pickBody: Click a table in the 3D view to see its QR code.
tables.noTablesBody: Add the tables of this area. Each gets its own QR code to print.
tables.name: Name
tables.sizeHint: Approximate size — used for the floor plan.
tables.deleteTableBody: Its printed QR code will stop working. This can't be undone.
tables.deleteAreaBody: Only empty areas can be deleted.
tables.newCodeBody: Use this if a QR sticker was copied or damaged. The old code will still open your menu, but no longer identifies the table — print and replace it.
tables.inUse: In use — its QR code opens the menu with this table

floor.help: Drag tables to place them. Select one to rotate it — or use the arrow keys and R.
floor.tableLabel: {label}, {seats} seats, at {x} by {y} metres, rotated {rotation} degrees
floor.footer: {name}: {width} × {depth} m · grid 50 cm. Double-click a table (or press Enter) to edit it.

printPage.note: Switched-off tables are not printed. Cut along the edges.

website.title: Website
website.description: Your café's home page. Edit it as a draft, check the preview, then publish.

hints.how_it_works: Explains QR ordering in 3 steps. The steps are standard; you choose the title and intro.
hints.story: Who you are, a photo, up to 3 highlights and a quote.
hints.gallery: Up to {max} photos of your place and products.
hints.specialties: Up to {max} featured items from your menu, with photos and prices.

website.publishedBody: Customers see the new version within a few minutes.
website.statusNever: Not published yet — customers see a simple default page.
website.translationHint: Visitors who choose {language} see these texts. Empty fields show the {main} text. Photos, hours and sections are shared.
website.heroHint: The first thing customers see. Always shown.
website.headline: Headline
website.label: Label
website.featuredNote: These are the items marked Featured in your menu.
website.noFeatured: No featured items yet. The section stays hidden on your website until you mark items as Featured in your menu (they also need a price).
website.hiddenSection: Hidden from your website. Switch it on to edit and show it.
website.hoursHint: Shown at the bottom of your website, with your address and phone from Settings.
website.discardBody: Your website goes back to the version customers see now. This can't be undone.
website.previewSteps: Scan the table QR code|Choose from the menu|We bring your order

notifications.approvedBody: {business} is approved on Serbi. Café setup is coming next.
notifications.languageAddedBody: Your café can now offer {language}. Add your translations in Menu and Website.

login.title: Sign in to Serbi
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Manage your café, menu, tables and orders.
login.restricted: Restricted access: café owners approved by Serbi and members of the Serbi team. Platform administrators use two-step verification.
login.staySignedIn: You stay signed in on this device.
login.noAccountTitle: No Serbi account for this {provider} account
login.noAccountBody: Café owners register with their email first (we need the business details and location). Then you can sign in with Google or Facebook using the same email.
login.linkInvalid: That link is invalid or has expired
login.linkInvalidBody: Sign in, or request a new link.
login.newToSerbi: New to Serbi? Create your café account first.

social.failed: Could not start sign-in with this provider. Please try again or use email.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter the email you registered with and we will send you a secure link to choose a new password.
forgot.expiredTitle: This reset link has expired or was already used
forgot.inboxBody: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a link to choose a new password. It expires after a short time.
forgot.noEmail: No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or try again in a minute.
forgot.expires: For security, the link expires after a short time.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: Use at least 10 characters with an upper-case letter, a digit and a symbol. You will be signed out on all devices afterwards.
reset.doneBody: Your password has been changed. For your security, you have been signed out on all devices. Sign in with your new password.
reset.notYou: Didn't change your password? Contact us right away so we can secure your account.

register.steps: Create your account and verify your email|The Serbi team reviews your application|Choose your subdomain — your café is live
register.pitch: Your café, your menu, your QR codes — live in minutes.
register.pitchBody: Branded menu, table ordering and live order tracking.
register.title: Create your Serbi account
register.subtitle: After verifying your email, the Serbi team reviews your application — usually within 24 hours.
register.terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
register.strengthHint: Use 10+ characters with upper case, a digit and a symbol.

location.body: Where customers find you. Used for your café page and maps.
location.searchPlaceholder: Café name or address, e.g. Artisan Brew Tunis
location.find: Find your business on the map
location.mapLabel: Map — click to place your business pin
location.mapAlt: Map — click to place your business
location.placeHint: Search above or click the map to place your pin
location.wrongPlace: Pin in the wrong place? Click the exact spot on the map — it re-centres on your pin. Use + / − to zoom.
location.notOnMap: Not on the map? Enter coordinates
location.noSearch: Map search is not configured. Enter your business coordinates and address.
location.zoomToSee: Zoom in to see cafés and restaurants
location.tapOrDrag: Tap a café to select it, or drag the pin
location.tapOrPlace: Tap a café to select it, or tap the map to place your pin

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.sentTo: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to confirm your email and submit your application.
checkEmail.sentToYou: We sent a verification link to your email address. Open it to confirm your email and submit your application.
checkEmail.noEmail: No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder. The link works on any device.

pending_approval.title: We're reviewing your application
pending_approval.body: Thanks for joining Serbi. Our team reviews new cafés, usually within 24 hours. We'll email you as soon as you're approved.

approved.title: You're approved!
approved.body: Your account is approved. Café setup (choosing your subdomain) is coming next.

rejected.title: We couldn't approve your application
rejected.body: We sent you an email with the reason. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.

active.title: Your café is live
active.body: Your café dashboard opens on your own subdomain.

onboarding.readyBody: It lives at {host}. We also sent you an email with the link.

next.menu: Add your menu|Categories, drinks and food, prices and photos.
next.tables: Create tables & print QR codes|One QR code per table or zone.
next.staff: Invite your staff|So your team can receive orders.

onboarding.addressGone: This café address is no longer available
onboarding.createFailed: Your café could not be created
onboarding.detailsBody: These details appear on your menu. We filled them in from your registration — check and adjust.
onboarding.contactBody: How customers reach your café. Shown on your menu — we filled in your registration details, change them if the café has its own.
onboarding.addressBody: Customers open your menu at this address. Use your café name — short and easy to type.
onboarding.holdNote: We keep this address for you for 30 minutes while you finish. Your printed QR codes never change, even if the address changes later.
onboarding.lookBody: We build your menu's colours from one brand colour. You can change it later; logo upload comes with your dashboard settings.
onboarding.agreementsBody: Your café's data (menu, orders, customers) belongs to your café. Serbi processes it for you under these agreements.
onboarding.reviewBody: Check everything, then create your café. You can change most of it later in your dashboard.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Orders from your tables and takeaway, live.
orders.acceptingHelp: Customers can order from your menu when this is on and you are open.
orders.hoursHint: Hours come from your website (Website → Opening hours).
orders.noOrdersYet: No open orders. New orders appear here instantly, with a sound.
orders.declineBody: The customer sees your reason on their phone.
orders.cancelBody: Use this if the order can't be served. The customer sees it on their phone.

push.title: Notifications on this device
push.body: Get a notification with sound for every new order, even when this page is closed.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then reload.
push.unsupported: This browser can't receive notifications. Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox, or the Serbi app on your phone.
push.install: On iPhone, add Serbi to your Home Screen first: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, open Serbi from there and turn notifications on.

push.readyTable: Your order is ready — it's coming to table {label}.
push.readyTakeaway: Your order is ready — pick it up at the counter, {name}.

receipt.subject: Your receipt — {cafe} #{number}
receipt.title: Thank you for your order!
receipt.intro: {cafe} accepted your order. Here is your receipt.
receipt.why: You receive this email because you entered your address when ordering at {cafe}. It is used only for this order.
receipt.tagline: Ordered with Serbi · QR menus and ordering for cafés

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: How your café is doing, compared with the period just before.
stats.unpaidHint: Open orders not marked as paid
stats.emptyHint: Orders appear here once customers order from the menu QR.

busy.title: Busy hours
busy.hint: Orders by day and hour (café time).
